description:
Activate Grim Poppet by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Omni-Changeling.
Flourishing Defenses triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Omni-Changeling by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Grim Poppet.
Flourishing Defenses triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

uses.name: Omni-Changeling
uses.cardState: as a copy of Grim Poppet and with toughness 2 or greater
